tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows mild normocytic, normochromic anemia (low hemoglobin and hematocrit, normal MCV and MCH), with normal leukocyte and erythrocyte counts. Platelet count is at the upper normal limit, but platelet distribution width is markedly elevated, suggesting increased platelet size variability, possibly due to reactive or regenerative processes. Further clinical correlation and investigation of anemia and platelet changes are recommended.
